Every answer grounded in how your business works

Joule Work is powered by SAP Knowledge Graph, a robust enterprise agent gateway, and agentic thinking—working together across your SAP landscape to ground every response in real business context, execute with precision, and scale with your processes. Fully managed by SAP.

Agentic thinking: Coordinate AI agents, tools, and business workflows through intelligent orchestration that manages multi-step tasks, connects actions across processes, and helps drive reliable, end-to-end execution.

Agent gateway: Joule Work is backed by a secure, enterprise-ready agent gateway that enforces identity, access, and policy controls at runtime. It governs agent communications, tool use, and human oversight to keep AI-driven workflows within your organization’s guardrails.

SAP Knowledge Graph: Ground AI in your enterprise context with SAP Knowledge Graph, connecting business data, relationships, and processes to deliver more relevant, accurate, and context-aware outcomes.

Explore SAP Knowledge Graph 

SAP is helping companies gain a competitive edge

SAP runs SAP: Proving the Autonomous Enterprise starts with a unified AI engagement layer

FAQ

Joule Work is a dynamic workspace that brings together your data, applications, and agent workflows in one place—so teams can answer any business question and execute reliable agentic workflows at scale, without switching between systems. People express what they want to accomplish, and Joule Assistants surface the right insights, automate routine work, and coordinate AI agents so people can focus on the decisions that move the business forward. Joule Work also provides seamless access to Joule Studio, where people can use intent-based development to build and integrate custom AI agents or workflows across their entire landscape.

Joule Assistants coordinate Joule Agents through deep role and business context. Once directed by the assistant, agents connect relevant data, tools and applications to perform specific tasks such as analyzing data, triggering actions, interacting with systems, and executing steps in a workflow. Joule Assistants surface through Joule Work.

Multi-agent systems are networks of AI agents that collaborate to complete tasks—breaking complex work into coordinated actions that speed decisions and automate end-to-end processes.

AI agent orchestration in Joule Work is how Joule Assistants coordinate multiple specialized Joule Agents to execute workflows end to end. It allows agents to work together in sequence or in parallel to turn intent into action. That orchestration is backed by a robust, secure, enterprise-ready agent gateway and grounded in the business and data context only SAP Knowledge Graph can deliver.

Joule Work improves how teams get work done by turning intent into action—activating Joule Assistants and Joule Agents to run workflows across systems, automate routine cross-functional work instantly instead of letting it sit in inboxes, and keep work moving from insight to outcome.

Joule Work is an engagement layer for interacting with assistants and agents—not the source of governance itself. Governance is built into the SAP Business AI Platform, where role-based access, data permissions, and policy controls are enforced, with monitoring, auditability, and human oversight where needed. Learn more about SAP's approach to responsible AI.

Joule Work is natively integrated with Joule Studio and SAP Integration Suite. Joule Studio gives business users an intent-based development environment to build reliable custom agents or workflows without technical heavy lifting. The same environment gives pro developers the flexibility to use the best-in-class tools of their choosing. From there, A2A and MCP open-standard integrations ensure you can connect the apps, data, and agents across your entire landscape.
